title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-15
content:
Today goals
- Finalize PRD edits for hosted-api v1.3 rollout and attach to release doc.
- Follow up with infra + SRE on autoscale test window and rollback runbook.
- Quick stakeholder sync (GTM + Sales + SRE) 2pm \u00131 align on canary % and metrics.

Morning notes / quick log
09:00 \u00131 Review PRD, addressed tech feedback from Ben: clarified batching defaults + KV-cache behavior for short seq.
09:30 \u00131 Pinged infra (Sofi) for autoscale test: requested a dedicated 2-hour window Tues 03/17 10\u001312 PT. Need confirmation by EOD.
10:15 \u00131 Drafted release one-pager for sales (attached link) \u00131 highlight latency SLO, cost delta vs. previous model, recommended customer messaging.

PRD edits (items to finish)
- API contract: add example for streaming + function calling (Ben asked for explicit error cases) \u00131 DONE (needs review).
- Batching config: default window + recommended max tokens per request \u00131 TODO (Sofia to confirm safe defaults).
- Rollout policy: add canary schedule (5% -> 25% -> 100%) + automated rollback criteria (error rate > 3% OR 95th latency regressed by 30% over baseline) \u00131 DRAFT.
- Observability: list of dashboards and alerts to enable during canary (per-route latency, token counts, error types) \u00131 TODO (obs team).

Stakeholder follow-ups (owners + due)
- SRE (Ben) \u00131 provide runbook snippets for rollback & emergency scaling \u00131 due 2026-03-16.
- Infra (Sofia) \u00131 confirm autoscale test window and expected capacity headroom for canary \u00131 due EOD 2026-03-15.
- GTM (Maya) \u00131 finalize customer-facing messaging and sales FAQ \u00131 due 2026-03-16.
- Legal (Raj) \u00131 confirm data-retention text for hosted customers in EU region \u00131 requested, waiting response.

Launch checklist (high level)
- [ ] PRD final sign-off (product + eng + SRE)
- [ ] Release one-pager for sales + support (GTM review)
- [ ] Autoscale test run (infra)
- [ ] Canary schedule + feature flags ready (eng)
- [ ] Observability/alerts configured (obs)
- [ ] Rollback runbook written and tested (SRE)
- [ ] Post-launch eval prompt set ready (quality monitoring)

Risks / open questions
- Risk: If autoscale test shows lower headroom than expected, canary must be reduced \u00131 need contingency plan (pre-agreed canary communication and second-tier model fallback).
- Question: Do we require a legal signoff for EU-specific logging text before canary in EU region? (Raj asked for examples from previous launches)
- Unresolved: Exact metric threshold for automated rollback \u00131 SRE suggested 3% error rate; engineering asked for 5% to avoid noisy rollbacks. Need final decision.

Quick TODOs (today)
- Send reminder to Sofia about autoscale window (ASAP).
- Iterate PRD sections: rollout + observability (finish by noon).
- Prep slides for 2pm stakeholder sync (5 slides): overview, schedule, risks, metrics, ask.
- Add sales FAQ Q/A entries based on Maya's comments.

Notes-to-self / ephemeral
- Keep the canary small until we validate KV-cache benefit for short completion workloads.
- Check cost delta numbers in spreadsheet: sheet "hosted-api-cost-model" (link in Confluence).
- If legal delays > 24h, consider region-staggered rollout (US first).

End-of-day checklist
- Did Sofia confirm autoscale window? 
- Did Ben update runbook?
- Did GTM sign off on messaging?

Misc links to attach before saving final PRD
- Confluence: hosted-api-launch-plan (section: metrics + rollback)
- GH PR: 256 (implementation for feature flags)
- Sheet: hosted-api-cost-model (tab: canary-estimates)

Next day priorities (2026-03-16)
- Confirm infra + run autoscale test (if scheduled)
- Final PRD sign-off and tag release branch
- Coordinate canary kickoff (timeline + on-call coverage)
